During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''governor''' ruled over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The local [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] maintained good relations with the Empire, and the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] had few conflicts with the Rodian [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]], [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]]. Although aware of the Rodians' reputation as valued criminal employees, the governor did not initiate a crackdown, believing that the Empire benefited more from Rodia's ready supply of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
